_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior garage door repaint. Context prefix GDRP (Garage Door RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes (GRDR is NC garage door, DRRP is entry door RP). Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single spec. EA-based estimation. 3 substrate materials (steel/wood/composite), 4 substrate states (sound/chalking/failing/rust). QT3-QT4 only. Sibling to SF_GARAGE_DOOR_EXT_NC (GRDR prefix).

paintable_items.name: Exterior garage door assembly
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from NC spec. Same physical item (garage door assembly). EA-based — each door assembly counted individually regardless of size. Covers all panels, recesses, window inserts, panel edges at articulation joints. Does NOT include casing/trim (SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 scope).

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes include GRDR (NC garage door), DRRP (entry door RP), TRRP (trim RP), WSRP (siding RP). GDRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_GDRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_GDRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_GDRP_DEGLOSS_STEEL, TSK_GDRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER, TSK_GDRP_PRIME_DTM_SPRAY, TSK_GDRP_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_GDRP_LEAPFROG_VERIFY_1

expected_modules.notes: Condition assessment — visual inspection, adhesion test, rust evaluation (steel), moisture test (wood), existing coating ID. MANDATORY first module for repaint.
Protection setup — driveway/apron (canvas NOT poly), siding mask (spray), window mask (if present), weatherstrip protect, track/hardware mask, bottom seal management, equipment setup.
Surface preparation — substrate and condition driven. Steel: degloss + scuff (sound) or scrape + feather (failing) or SSPC-SP3 debride (rust). Wood: sand + fill. Composite: mixed-material prep.

Primer application — condition-driven scope. Sound paint: spot prime bare areas only. Chalking: chalk-binding full prime. Failing: spot or full prime. Rust: DTM/zinc on bare metal. Wood six-side seal verification.
First finish coat — leapfrog technique for sectional doors. Spray primary, brush for recesses.
Intercoat inspection, sand (QT4), repair, dust removal.
Second finish coat — leapfrog. Bottom seal prop after coat 2.
Protection teardown, bottom seal reinstall, articulation test, tool clean.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — visible from street. QT5 excluded — utility surface.

application_method.notes: Spray primary. Brush for recesses. Roller PROHIBITED on metal doors.

sheen.notes: Gloss excluded for RP — requires substrate perfection not achievable over existing paint. Satin is most common.

substrate_state.notes: 4 repaint input states. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only. SS_EXT_CHALKING is common on large flat garage door surfaces.

surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs registered by NC spec.

proposed_modifiers.description: Quality tier modifier on coating tasks

stacking_partition.formula: Effective Rate = Baseline Rate / (Pool_Modifiers x SHARED_Modifiers) + ADDITIVE
stacking_partition.max_theoretical_stack: Double (1.85) x carriage (1.30) x wood (1.15) x rust (2.00) = ~5.53x on prep. Multiplicative cap 4.0x applies — recommend T&M for extreme combinations.
stacking_partition.common_scenario: Single steel flush sound QT3 spray = 1.00x baseline

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Sound paint — adhesion test passes. Spot prime thin/bare areas. May skip prime entirely if no bare areas.
Chalking surface requires full-coverage chalk-binding primer. Cannot spot prime over chalk.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot or full prime + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Failing paint — scrape + feather + prime. Scope depends on bare area percentage.

proposed_configurations.description: DTM primer on bare steel + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Steel-only. SSPC-SP3 debridement + DTM primer on bare areas + finish coats.

proposed_profiles.description: Finish coat on primed surface — 350 SF/gal

deduplication_notes: Garage door CASING/TRIM painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 — this spec covers the door panel assembly only.
Driveway/apron protection IS this spec's responsibility.
Adjacent siding masking during spray IS this spec's responsibility.
Entry door repaint (SF_DOOR_EXT_RP_v1) is completely separate — different context prefix, PS keys, and EA counts.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_GDRP_ prefix
RULE 10: ITM_GARAGE_DOOR must be used exactly as registered
RULE 11: Downstream agents use ONLY enum values from this resolution
